name: Leech of Fear (Dark Thaumaturgy (Path of Phobos), Advanced)

system.activation: Feeds on a frightened or intimidated victim's terror as if it were vitae, once per night per target. Spend the usual Blood Trait and make a number of Simple Tests equal to six minus the target's Courage Traits; each win or tie grants a Fear Trait usable exactly like a Blood Trait, though unspent Fear Traits vanish at sunrise.
